metadata.chunk_title: Transfer of academic credit for students wishing to complete a degree at ASU.

facts.value: MyPath2ASU® is a set of customized tools to help transfer students from U.S. regionally accredited institutions (including international students transferring from U.S. regionally accredited institutions). MyPath2ASU® creates a seamless transfer experience to ASU after earning credits or an associate’s degree from a U.S. community college or university. Plan a path into your major of choice by taking classes that transfer to ASU—shortening your time to degree completion.
